description: A shell script that manages Docker Compose setup for Apache Superset, including port allocation, environment setup, and command handling.

methods.name: is_port_available
methods.description: Checks if a specific port is available on the system using lsof, netstat, or ss.

methods.name: is_port_free
methods.description: Checks if a port is free and not already claimed in the script session.

methods.name: find_and_claim_port
methods.description: Finds the next available port starting from a base port and claims it.

methods.name: get_running_port
methods.description: Retrieves the port number from a running container or falls back to a default.

methods.name: print_connection_info
methods.description: Displays the URLs and ports for accessing the services.

methods.name: open_browser
methods.description: Opens the default web browser to the development server URL.
